tips.text: Farm the six Lazulite Toroids from Exploiter first, and use the Circuit only for a blueprint that refuses to drop.
Run Exploiter with an active Resource Booster and a Resourceful Retriever companion; they halve the six required kills to three, while drop-chance boosters do nothing.
Ask recruit chat for a host with spare Thermia; only the player who inserts it into the Condenser spends theirs.
Defend Thermia Fractures with Amesha, casting Benevolent Decoy three times over the canister, or with Octavia, placing a high-range Mallet and Amp away from the fracture.
In phase 1, explode a Condensed Thermia canister between the two rear vents to thaw both at once.
Carry the orange Thermia cells from phase 1 to the phase 2 door, and keep one player inside Deck 12 so the runners are not reloaded into phase 1.
In phase 2, drag the ground coolant canisters away from her so she cannot re-cool herself.
Expect to run Exploiter solo; public squads for it barely exist now.
Never put a fracture canister on or near a road; Coil Drives run it over and void the run.
Keep radiation-status weapons off a fracture defense; the procs make teammates shoot the canister.
Grab the drop before anything else; a host migration mid-boss can eat it.
The fight is easy but slow, 10 to 16 minutes a clear, and the whole grind is wall-clock time.
Most players say the frame is worth it, though many call the Exploiter grind a never-again.
